card.name: Scattered parts of drug label instructions
card.fires_on: No shared word or setting; it fires on scattered pieces such as a digit, a letter inside a drug or lab term, and a few plain words, mostly in topical-use or dosing instructions.

modes.label: Partway through words
modes.description: Fires on a single letter or short piece inside a longer drug or medical term.

modes.label: Digit in dosing interval
modes.description: Fires on a digit that begins a number of hours in an application schedule.
modes.example: Apply twice daily morning and evening (every <<1>>2 hours), for 3 consecutive days
